annotations.title: Find a worked economy to start from

description: Worked economies to start from. With `query` (a request in its own words), returns the closest worked examples (whole specs that check and go live in the tests), the closest of 112 real or trending economies rated against loot (great / some / a-lot / cannot, with what carries each or what is missing), and what loot can’t do exactly in the request, each with the nearest versions it can. With `name`, returns that example’s whole spec. With neither, lists every example.

name.description: An example’s name, to get its whole spec.

query.description: What the person wants, in a few words.
